lessons: Monthly Cycle: 4H timeframe to evaluate the week. High probability is SSMT with previous week confluenced with 4H TPD.
Weekly Cycle: 1H timeframe to evaluate daily behavior. Look for SSMT between two days (Mon/Tue, Tue/Wed, Wed/Thu, Thu/Fri, Fri/Mon) confluenced with 1H TPD (works without too).
Daily Cycle: 15M timeframe for session-level setups (London, NY AM, NY PM, Asia). High probability is SSMT confluenced with 15M TPD (works without too).
90-Minute Cycle: 5M timeframe used exclusively for the 90-minute session/quarter focus.
